base_counts: v2's stored counts minus the counts of the plots left out (results/v2/second/bgdrop_check_llama3.3-70b.json says exact)

not_confined_to_works_the_model_names.E1_rule: screen works not named in H1, on the full folds' canons: within-era AUC at least 0.70 and an interval that excludes 0.5; fewer than 10 such works cannot be read
not_confined_to_works_the_model_names.residual_test_rule: primary adaptations whose source is not named in H2: decision test p (mean_over_sources) below 0.05; fewer than 5 such adaptations cannot be read
not_confined_to_works_the_model_names.reading: each says where an effect sits, so each matters only where the test itself passes (PLAN Section 10)
